About

Tin-Yeh Huang

HONG KONG

I study Product Engineering at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. This site brings together research and engineering work I have contributed to, public service, and some personal writing.

My research contributions include analysis, figures, and writing. In engineering work, I care about whether a tool is actually useful to someone. I have also served as a student representative and taken part in community and social innovation work.
